name: recoil_app_leave_network_state_on_try_become_current
description: RecoilApp_LeaveNetworkState::OnTryBecomeCurrent destroys the cached DirectPlay local player, shuts down the engine, shuts down the sound backend, and accepts the state transition.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

A direct full-call smoke is intentionally not used because OnTryBecomeCurrent drives global engine and backend shutdown. The focused smokes cover the nontrivial composed callees while Binary Ninja/source evidence covers the exact orchestrating call order and return value.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation at 0x42f9d0 validate the exact call order: zNetwork_DPlay::DestroyCachedLocalPlayer, RecoilApp::ShutdownEngine(&g_RecoilApp), zSndBackend::Shutdown, then return 1.

The dependency frontier for 0x42f9d0 has no visible source blockers after accepting zNetwork_DPlay_DestroyCachedLocalPlayer, RecoilApp::ShutdownEngine, and zSndBackend::Shutdown as functional dependencies.
The native dependency smokes verify the cached local DirectPlay player destruction path and the sound backend shutdown release/gate behavior used by this state entry.
